groups.description: List of all group names associated with this application role.

has_unlimited_seats.description: Indicates whether this application role has no limit on the number of users who can be assigned to it.

key.description: The unique identifier for this application role.

name.description: The human-readable name of this application role.

a_48x48.description: URL to the user's 48x48 pixel avatar image.

avatar_urls.description: Collection of URLs for the user's avatar image in different sizes.

display_name.description: The user's full name as it appears in the Atlassian interface.

email_address.description: The user's email address. This is used as the primary identifier for looking up user information.

expand.description: Comma-separated list of additional user details to include in the response.

name.description: The display name of the group.

groups.description: List of groups the user belongs to, determining their access rights and permissions.
